cases.name: every-statistic-over-the-whole-run
cases.description: One number for the WHOLE run, on every row — the third axis after accumulate= inside a record and <gen type="running"> down a column. The values are the textbook set whose POPULATION standard deviation is exactly 2: dividing by n-1 would give about 2.14, so the line tells the two conventions apart. Median 4.5 pins the even-count rule, mean 5 the ratio, and min/max return an element that already exists rather than a recomputed one.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="s" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="N"><gen type="text" value="2,4,4,4,5,5,7,9" order="sequential"/></sequence><sequence name="Sum"><gen type="stat" of="N" op="sum"/></sequence><sequence name="Mean"><gen type="stat" of="N" op="mean"/></sequence><sequence name="Median"><gen type="stat" of="N" op="median"/></sequence><sequence name="Min"><gen type="stat" of="N" op="min"/></sequence><sequence name="Max"><gen type="stat" of="N" op="max"/></sequence><sequence name="Count"><gen type="stat" of="N" op="count"/></sequence><sequence name="Sd"><gen type="stat" of="N" op="stddev"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{N}} ${{Sum}} ${{Mean}} ${{Median}} ${{Min}} ${{Max}} ${{Count}} ${{Sd}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-statistic-keeps-the-exact-decimals-a-running-total-keeps
cases.description: sum, min and max are the last value of the corresponding RUNNING column, which is how the fixed-point arithmetic is kept from drifting between the two features: 19.99 + 0.01 + 0.01 is 20.01 everywhere rather than 20.009999999999998 in one of them. min returns the winning element with its own spelling, so 007 stays 007. decimals= rounds a ratio, and a half goes AWAY FROM ZERO — 117.045 becomes 117.05, not the 117.04 round-half-to-even would give.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Money"><gen type="text" value="19.99,0.01,0.01" order="sequential"/></sequence><sequence name="Padded"><gen type="text" value="007,10,9" order="sequential"/></sequence><sequence name="Half"><gen type="text" value="117.04,117.05,117.045" order="sequential"/></sequence><sequence name="Total"><gen type="stat" of="Money" op="sum"/></sequence><sequence name="Smallest"><gen type="stat" of="Padded" op="min"/></sequence><sequence name="Rounded"><gen type="stat" of="Half" op="mean" decimals="2"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Total}} ${{Smallest}} ${{Rounded}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-row-that-knows-whether-it-is-above-average
cases.description: The question a statistic exists to answer, and the one nothing else can: the average is not knowable until the last row exists, while a conditional gen is evaluated as the row is built. A parent-filtered cell takes no part in the statistic — the same rule accumulate= follows — so the average here is over the three rows that carry an Amount, not over six.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="s" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Kind"><gen type="text" value="a,b,a,b,a,b" order="sequential"/></sequence><sequence name="Amount" parent="Kind.a"><gen type="text" value="10,20,30" order="sequential"/></sequence><sequence name="Average"><gen type="stat" of="Amount" op="mean"/></sequence><sequence name="Rows"><gen type="stat" of="Amount" op="count"/></sequence><sequence name="Flag"><gen if="Amount > Average" type="text" value="above"/><gen type="text" value="not-above"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Kind}} ${{Amount}} ${{Average}} ${{Rows}} ${{Flag}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-statistic-with-no-mode-goes-where-it-must
cases.description: The shape a reader actually writes: no mode=, no engine=, just a statistic. The other cases here pin mode="memory", so the ROUTER is never exercised by them and a port that sent this config to the streaming engine and let the refusal escape would look green. The streaming engine refuses a statistic by design; when nobody named an engine, that refusal is answered by building the run in memory, not by failing.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="prices" local="en"><sequence name="Price"><gen type="number" value="10..200"/></sequence><sequence name="Average"><gen type="stat" of="Price" op="mean" decimals="2"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Price}},${{Average}}</data></line></block></tdc>
